No rejection grounds found: no evidence of non-existence, strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy; entity appears active with a live website. Declared HS 854430 (wiring harness/ignition sets) is consistent with the company's cable and wiring-harness product lines, but HS was not the object of this check.
